0002a4f8.evidence: Compares a desired HCAN mailbox descriptor array (param_2: 16 x 16-byte records for channel 0, 6 for channel 1) against live registers: HCAN0_BCR_W 0xffffe402 / HCAN1_BCR_W 0xffffe602 expect 0x803e; MBCR/MBIMR rebuilt from record bytes and compared (HCAN0_MBCR_W 0xffffe404, HCAN0_MBIMR_W 0xffffe414, HCAN1_MBCR_W 0xffffe604, HCAN1_MBIMR_W 0xffffe614); HCAN0_IMR_W 0xffffe416 / HCAN1_IMR_W 0xffffe616 expect 0xfcfe; HCAN0_LAFMH_W 0xffffe41e + HCAN0_LAFML_W 0xffffe41c (and HCAN1_LAFMH_W 0xffffe61e / HCAN1_LAFML_W 0xffffe61c) must be zero; per-mailbox MC control/data bytes checked at HCAN0_MC0[1]_B 0xffffe420 + 8*(mb&0xf) (MC0[5]/MC0[6]/MC0[7]/MC0[8] hold ID/DLC fields). Returns nonzero on any mismatch. Called from ref_canSetup 0xd9f4 (jsr @r13 at 0xda3e/0xda4e; pool 0xdb20 = 0x2a4f8) in a <=2-iteration retry loop with ref_CANControllerSetup(0, 0x4e01c or 0x4e11c, 0x10) and (1, 0x4e21c, 6); after >1 tries sets error flag 0xffffa410.

00028eb8.evidence: Reads RX buffer 0xffffbab8 (pool 0x28fc8): bytes 0-1, 2-3, 5-6 assembled big-endian into u16 cells 0xffffbad4/bad6/bad8 (pools 0x28fcc/0x28fd0/0x28fd8), bytes 4 and 7 stored as u8 at 0xffffbada/badc. Three words + two bytes, not eight raw bytes. Re-verified this pass.

000291dc.evidence: Packs 8 bytes into 0xffffbaf4 (pool 0x292a4): u16 0xffffbafc (rpm) at +0/+1, u16 0xffffbafe at +2/+3, u16 0xffffbb00 (speed) at +4/+5, bytes from 0xffffbb02/bb03 at +6/+7, then jmp 0x99b0 queue (pool 0x292bc). CAN 0x201 descriptor at ROM 0x4df1c = 0000 0201 0001 0800 ffffbaf4 0100 0000 (BE id 0x201, len 8, buffer 0xffffbaf4) - ROM bytes re-read this pass.
